A '''light squadron''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]]. The light squadron was generally configured in one of two ways. The first configuration consisted of two [[attack line]]s, a [[skirmish line]], and a [[recon line]], for a force of between twenty and thirty ships. The second configuration was composed of two recon lines, a skirmish line, and a [[pursuit line]], for a force totaling between twenty-five and thirty-five ships.
